results.mechanism: Bug 2023381 (91bfadad8e0a) added the per-inhibit int mWakeLockType field AND the exact MOZ_DIAGNOSTIC_ASSERT(mWakeLockType != Unsupported) at WakeLockListener.cpp:897, converting what was previously a graceful 'Unsupported' bail-out (return NS_ERROR_FAILURE) into a fatal assert. When the DBus wake-lock backend has fallen back to Unsupported and an uninhibit request then arrives via the observer broadcast, UninhibitScreensaver aborts on the new assertion.

Bug 2039555 flips network.http.happy_eyeballs_enabled to default-on for nightly, enabling concurrent IPv4/IPv6 connection racing and cross-IP-family retries. That lets a transaction remain in one connection entry's pending queue while being reprocessed as new via ProcessNewTransaction, so CheckTransInPendingQueue's RemoveTransFromConnEntry returns foundInPendingQ=true and MOZ_DIAGNOSTIC_ASSERT(!foundInPendingQ) fires.

The migration to app-services logins introduced create_login_store_with_nss_keymanager, which calls LoginStore::new(path, ...).unwrap(); when the logins SQLite DB is corrupt/not-a-database, LoginStore::new returns Err(UnexpectedLoginsApiError "file is not a database") and the unwrap panics, matching the MOZ_CRASH_REASON and the unwrap_failed panic stack exactly.

A themed <input type=range> painted into a content-process recording DrawTarget (via an SVG image used as a CSS image layer) reaches Theme::PaintRange -> PaintCircleShadow, which calls DrawTargetRecording::CreateSimilarDrawTargetForFilter to build the thumb-shadow blur target; the recording DT can't back that filter op and deliberately MOZ_CRASHes. Bug 1971450 reworked range/meter/progress appearance and PaintRange, routing range widgets through this themed shadow path in that context.

Bug 1971158 vendored llama.cpp, introducing third_party/llama.cpp/ggml/src/ggml-threading.cpp whose file-scope global `std::mutex ggml_critical_section_mutex` gets a dynamic initializer (_GLOBAL__sub_I_ggml_threading.cpp) run at xul.dll load via dllmain_crt_process_attach/initterm. Frame #0 is that global's std::mutex construction; the fault is a startup DLL-init crash (sibling bug 1986900 = 'invalid instruction', i.e. the vendored ggml objects use a CPU instruction baseline above some users' hardware), attributed to the first ggml global initializer to run.

Bug 1980056 reworked mozjemalloc's page-size model, splitting a fixed 4KiB logical page from the OS real page (16KiB on Apple Silicon) and deleting the SubPage size classes. The purge path (arena_t::Purge/PurgeLoop/FindDirtyPages) computes dirty-page spans and madvise/decommit lengths in units keyed to gPagesPerRealPage/gPageSize2Pow; a miscalculation in that new logical/real page accounting yields a bad pointer or length (or over-indexes the chunk page-map) during purge on macOS, faulting in Purge.

Bug 543435 made docshell Initialize fallible; a half-initialized docshell reaches nsDocShell::ShouldDoInitialAboutBlankSyncLoad (via DoURILoad) and dereferences a null/uninitialized member, faulting on thread 0.
results.refutation: Candidate 3c99a43d1d94 is bug 2003244, landed 2026-01-06, ~6 weeks AFTER the crash build 20251124214625 (2025-11-24), so it is not present in the crashing binary; furthermore it is a defensive fix that converts a fatal NS_ENSURE_TRUE into a non-fatal NS_WARNING, i.e. crash mitigation, not a crash-introducing change.

results.mechanism: The wgpu update (bug 2005294) re-vendors wgpu-hal/src/dx12/adapter.rs, whose Adapter::expose() calls .unwrap() on DX12 CheckFeatureSupport/GetDesc2 HRESULT results; when adapter probing hits an error HRESULT (e.g. 0x887A0005 device suspended/removed), the unwrap panics, and the Rust panic hook fires MOZ_Crash and aborts the GPU process.

The patch adds HttpChannelChild::SendOnDataFinished, which dispatches the new nsIThreadRetargetableStreamListener::OnDataFinished onto the retargeted (off-main-thread) OnDataAvailable target, gated by the new network.send_OnDataFinished pref that defaults true on nightly. The resulting nsDocumentOpenInfo::OnDataFinished AddRefs a JS-implemented (XPCWrappedJS) stream listener off the main thread, tripping MOZ_RELEASE_ASSERT(NS_IsMainThread()) in nsXPCWrappedJS::AddRef.

The changeset reorders PendingTransactionQueue::CancelAllTransactions to collect raw nsHttpTransaction* pointers, then Clear() the mUrgentStartQ/mPendingTransactionTable (which hold the only strong RefPtrs via PendingTransactionInfo) BEFORE looping to call trans->Close(). If the queue held the last reference, the transaction is freed before Close() runs, so Close()'s mReqHeaderBuf.Truncate() decrements a StringBuffer refcount on freed memory — the exact atomic fetch_sub crash in the stack.

MOZ_ASSERT(isValid) in EncoderAgent::SetState fires on an illegal state transition (→Configured) during the reconfigure fallback: EncoderTemplate::Reconfigure attempts an on-the-fly reconfigure, and on reject calls mAgent->Drain()→DryUntilDrain which SetState(Configured) from a state the validator rejects. All of this code (the state machine + the config-diff/reconfigure machinery) is new in bug 1749047, landed 2023-12-22, one day before the crash build.

TexUnpackSurface::BlitSd takes the GPU-copy fast path (AllowBlitSd && BlitSd) for a SurfaceDescriptor upload, attaches the destination WebGL texture to a scratch FBO, and MOZ_CRASHes when fCheckFramebufferStatus != FRAMEBUFFER_COMPLETE — i.e. a non-color-renderable texture format/level wrongly reaches the blit path (GPU process, Windows). Bug 1979112 (this exact signature) is Bugzilla-confirmed regressed_by 1972649, so that bug's Canvas/WebGL change is the real cause.

Reftests run only in CI and are never shipped to or executed on end-user machines, so this patch cannot produce these content-process field crashes; the real regressor is the C++ that implemented/enabled the cross-shadow-boundary common-ancestor logic, not this test-only part of bug 1965847.

results.mechanism: The crash is inside the injected third-party McAfee filesystem-hook DLL (fcagff.dll), which intercepts a normal NSPR FileRead / nsFileStreamBase::Read and raises an exception from its own hook trampoline (frames #1-#6 + unknown addr #7 -> RaiseException). This is an external/injected-code fault, not a Firefox code defect.
results.refutation: Changeset 0067817ee3f7 (bug 1771789, WebRTC Audio/Video) modifies ONLY web-platform test files (a .ini metadata file and the MediaStreamTrack-independent-clones test .html). It ships no browser code and cannot touch NSPR, netwerk file streams, or an injected third-party DLL. Additionally the signature has 0 occurrences in crash-stats, so there is no volume or regression window to associate with it.

results.mechanism: A microtask dequeued into JS::Rooted<MustConsumeMicroTask> job in the javascript_options_use_js_microtask_queue() branch of PerformMicroTaskCheckPoint is destroyed without being consumed (mMicroTask still non-undefined), tripping MOZ_CRASH("Didn't consume MicroTask") in ~MustConsumeMicroTask; this path only executes because the JS MicroTaskQueue was enabled by default (bug 1997192, the regressor recorded on the existing signature bug 2003956).
results.refutation: 55652ba60d45 (bug 1999913) only marks SafelyInitialized<T>::create() and some wasm AnyRef ctors as constexpr and removes an ifdef; the body still value-initializes (return T()) with identical runtime behavior. It does not touch microtask dequeue/consume/run bookkeeping, so it cannot leave a microtask unconsumed. The signature's own bug 2003956 is regressed_by bug 1997192 (Enable JS MicroTaskQueue by default), not this changeset.

results.mechanism: OnStartRequest sees mStatus==NS_ERROR_LOCAL_NETWORK_ACCESS_DENIED and calls ProcessLNAActions, which dereferences mTransaction at nsHttpChannel.cpp:8018 (mTransaction->GetTargetIPAddressSpace()); mTransaction is null on this stream-pump/retry path, giving a null-pointer crash in the LNA permission feature.
results.refutation: Changeset 1901f0e0dd78 (bug 1872780) only removes the layout.css.size-adjust.enabled CSS font-descriptor pref (FontFace.webidl, FontFaceImpl.cpp, StaticPrefList.yaml, font_face.rs); it touches no networking/nsHttpChannel/mTransaction/LNA code and cannot affect this path.
